_note: Canonical palette for the Build & Brew kit. These hexes match the templates in templates/archetypes/ and AGENT.md exactly. If you change one, change all three. Derived from the NextWork kernel; see scripts/sync-from-kernel.md.
rules: Ground is paper #f8f5f1 (never pure white) or leather #1b1918 (never pure black).
One accent per post. There is NO standing default. Ask every time; 'none' (fully tonal) is always a good answer. A small highlight, never a big saturated block.

On a warm graded event photo, prefer a warm accent: pumpkin, canary, or sand. Cornflower and plum are cold and clash with the warm grade, so keep them for cool or screenshot posts, not warm event photos. Emerald is the signature green: fine as a small highlight, never a block.
Plum stays out of large colour blocks.
Canary #ffdd2d is the yellow highlight accent.
